title: Home Oxygen Therapy Pickup Lead Time and Equipment Recovery Charges Schedule
content:
# Pickup and Recovery Charges — Home Oxygen Therapy

When Home Oxygen Therapy equipment is given back, the following figures apply per system class: the business days after a confirmed return within which the equipment is picked up, the calendar days after the confirmed pickup date after which equipment still not recovered is charged, the charge for a stationary system not recovered, the charge per portable cylinder not recovered, and the charge for equipment recovered damaged beyond normal wear.

| System class | Pickup within (business days after a confirmed return) | Unrecovered after (calendar days from the confirmed pickup date) | Stationary system not recovered (USD) | Each portable cylinder not recovered (USD) | Recovered damaged beyond normal wear (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | 3 | 30 | 895.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 3 | 30 | 1150.00 | 85.00 | 150.00 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | 3 | 30 | 2450.00 | 0.00 | 300.00 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | 3 | 30 | 2980.00 | 0.00 | 350.00 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | 3 | 30 | 1650.00 | 0.00 | 200.00 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 3 | 30 | 1890.00 | 85.00 | 250.00 |

The per-cylinder charge is 0.00 for a class with no cylinders.

## Schedule questions

**Which classes carry a per-cylinder charge?** Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) and High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431), at 85.00 per cylinder.

**Which class carries the highest charge for a stationary system not recovered?** Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392), at 2980.00; the lowest is Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390), at 895.00.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Two portable cylinders not recovered on a High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) return are charged 85.00 each, 170.00 in total.
